name: HedgePay staking forceExit pays out the stake without clearing the staked balance
summary: The HedgePay HPAY staking proxy's implementation pays a staker's full balance on forceExit() but never reduces that balance or totalSupply, so the same stake can be paid out again by withdraw() or by repeated forceExit() calls, draining other stakers' HPAY.
notes: Anchor: sweeper 0x07eb2a01, through 2022 staker 0xf2552dd6 (EIP-7702 delegated), called forceExit and withdrew the same stake again in 0x48364ae2; only that second payout counts. The 2026-02-25 attacker (50 forceExits) and three copycats in the next 1,300 blocks repeated it.

HPAY has no DefiLlama price. The 2025 payout is valued at HPAY/BTCB spot reserves times BTCB; the 2026 drains at what each actor realised selling into that pair (26.0142 WBNB for the main attacker, 0.3221 WBNB for the copycats together).
Implementation 0xbe189fe9 (deployed in the ref tx) is unverified; the defect is established from execution: payouts that leave the staked balance in place.
